records.answer: Label exposed vaccines "DO NOT USE—TEMPERATURE EXCURSION" and move them to the correct storage conditions. Any staff member who hears an alarm or notices a temperature excursion on the TMD should immediately notify the primary or backup vaccine coordinator, or report the problem to their supervisor. In general, manufacturers analyze information about the magnitude of the temperature excursion and the total amount of time that temperatures were out of range, as well as information about the vaccine in question, to determine whether a vaccine is likely to still be viable.
